def: to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to

occurrences.text: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
